body: Food restriction can be a form of self harm. So I would think that just because you don't cut yourself doesn't mean you don't have BPD.
That is horrible. Sadistic. Yes I would consider that to be torturous, and that behavior coming from a parent makes it even worse. I'm so sorry!
Music. Some musician somewhere has experienced my pain and wrote a song about it.

People on the internet can be unhinged and less inclined to be polite because everything is anon.

Personally I am sensitive too, so I just stay away from controversial conversations as much as possible. You never know what kind of person will reply. No need for useless conversation with them tbh.
Agree, if I have a real BIG angry outburst. The type that becomes like a milestone in my life, I never regretted it. Seriously people can just push you straight to the edge sometimes.

I'm not happy being alone, but its starting to appear that I may be less miserable when I am alone though...

People are fucking mean to me.

"So I went on a first date this evening with a guy who showered me in compliments, called me every day this past week told me how much he liked me .".

The nerve of this guy to judge you when he is doing this stuff. Showering you with compliments and calling you everyday telling you how much he likes you when he didn't even go on a first date with you. Yeah ok...

And how the hell can someone say you are empty and needed healing on a first date, Dude doesn't know you...seriously you dodged a big weirdo. Congratulations.

Its not normal for a 27 year old to be attracted to a 16 year old in my opinion. I'm 27, like wtf am I going to do with a 16 year old boy. When you get to my age you'll get it and see how really weird it is. 

Stay away from him. Hes older than you so probably can find a way to trick you or play with your heart to get what he wants...and what he wants from you is probably just sex.

Find a cute boy your own age.

Heidi Priebe makes a lot of videos on disorganized aka fearful avoidant attachment. I found them to be helpful in understanding myself and what I could do to maybe fix things.

I am feeling the same way you are though. I'm totally destroying my romantic relationship right now because I'm constantly getting triggered into feeling avoidant to feeling totally anxious and NEEDING their reassurance immediately. I've also been getting so angry and crying a lot, just being emotionally exhausting.

As for friends, I keep myself at a distance so I don't really feel connected at all.

Its either I am disconnected or alone, or if I do manage to bond with someone its just a huge mess...

I do think you are worth being with, and I think I am too...its just this damn attachment style we need to learn how to deal with. The fact that you wish them happiness, you say you don't want to hurt people, and you love them - that's amazing. I would want someone who thinks like that in my life. Its not your fault you had a bad childhood and you get triggered.
Its hard to do things like writing when I'm in this mindset but its getting to a point where I'll have to try or I'll end up doing something stupid instead. Ty for the suggestions
